title: fix(pm): the clause-2 green line names the LABEL carriers it compared, and says the PR body was not read
body:
Part of #16770 — **option 3 only**, the one direction that card's triage routing admitted. #16770 is not addressed here as a whole: options 1 and 2 remain open, and both wait on the ruling #16303 is still asking for.

## What the line used to claim

`check-clause2-carriers --pair` closed its exit-0 line with a bare three-word clause about carriers agreeing, in all three of its branches. In this file a **carrier is a LABEL carrier**: `gated()` asks whether a carrier's labels came back readable, C1 compares `needs:contract-review` on the card against the same label on the PR, and the docblock's limb 3 imports the 2026-08-22 dual-carrier ruling for exactly that. The clause was **true about labels**.

But *carrier* is also this tree's word for the **documents** that carry the clause-2 declaration, and the clause sat one comma from `the clause-② declaration is …`. On a pair whose card declares `no` while its PR body declares `yes`, a careful reader takes that line as a **denial of the split** — a denial this gate cannot make. It reads the declaration from the card only; `declarationFromPullRequest` lives in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and is never imported here.

Re-measured on `origin/main` at `166db3cae`, with a firing control:

```
grep -c declarationFromPullRequest  scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs   0
grep -c declarationFromPullRequest  scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs   26   (control: the probe fires)
```

## What changed

The green line now states **what it compared** and closes with **what it did not read**:

```
✓ check-clause2-carriers: PR #N / card #M — the clause-② declaration is readable in the fixed
spelling, and the `needs:contract-review` LABEL is in the same state on both LABEL carriers (this
card and this PR). ⚠️ The clause above compares LABELS, ⛔ never two declarations: this run read
the clause-② declaration from the CARD only and did NOT read the PR body, so a PR body declaring
the opposite of this card is neither compared nor denied here (#16770).
```

The non-read sentence is appended **last**, so the optional review-of-record and widening clauses cannot bury it, and it is shared by every branch rather than paraphrased per branch.

⛔ **No join is built and no detection is added.** Nothing here reads the PR body's declaration. Naming one document authoritative (option 1) or refusing on a disagreement (option 2) both need #16303's answer, and #16303 is unanswered. `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` is untouched.

## The pin, and the ablation that proves it holds

A reworded sentence drifts back unless something holds it, so the green line moved into `greenPairLine()` — the self-test now pins the sentence **the run prints**, not a copy of it. One new battery, 14 assertions, both directions. The forbidden phrase is assembled at runtime rather than written out, so the pin is not a hit in its own scan.

| leg | mutation, proven on disk | self-test |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **GREEN** | none | **EXIT 0**, 1060 cases (base `166db3cae` = 1046; +14, rises only) |
| **RED · constant** | revert `LABEL_CARRIERS_AGREE` to the old bare clause; blob `a76e4ce0` → `5f4d4cf3`, phrase hits 0 → 1 | **EXIT 1**, 6 of 1060 failed |
| **RED · bypass** | leave the constant intact, inline the old clause in the plain branch; blob `a76e4ce0` → `fa24a662`, phrase hits 0 → 1 | **EXIT 1**, 3 of 1060 failed |
| **RESTORE** | `git checkout HEAD -- …` after each leg | blob back to `a76e4ce0c1ce6d57be5a091a7ce10555a368350c`, `git diff HEAD` empty |

The **bypass** leg is why the negative is pinned on the source and not only on the constants: a revert that never touches `LABEL_CARRIERS_AGREE` still reds.

⚠️ Honest note on method: the first attempt at the constant leg used a `perl -0pi` substitution whose anchor matched **nothing**. It exited 0, the blob was unchanged, and the self-test stayed green — a reading that would have read as "the pin fires" if the on-disk proof had not been taken. The legs above were re-run with an anchor asserted to match exactly once before any verdict was read.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`. The only path in the diff is `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`; `scripts/pm/**` is shipped by no package's `files[]`, so nothing already published moves. ⚠️ The label is the carrier the PR-scoped `Check Changeset` reads — a local `check:changeset-no-major` pass would not have answered it.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-2 on the finished diff: **no**. Nothing here widens an accept set, adds a schema key, a closed-set member, a published export or a registry entry. The diff narrows one sentence's claim and adds assertions.
- `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 34 → 35 and one roster entry, which is the ordinary cost of a new battery.
- Noted, not filed: the roster's long success sentence at the end of `selfTest()` enumerates batteries by hand and does not name this one. Nothing reads it and no gate compares it to `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`, so it is prose drift rather than a defect. Carrier: the next card that adds a battery to this file.
